messages.text:
I can’t refund twice what you paid. The policy limits the refund to the amount paid for the returned unit: **BRL 64.49** (refund-policy/v2/amount).

I’ve created a proposal for BRL 64.49. To request it, confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a reply in chat won’t confirm it.
